scope: Light, source-only preparation while the activation-aware full pack owns the heavy window.

runtime_agreement.change: The explicit --suite capability path now compares the numpy artifact oracle with Rust/Metal on the exact G_math prompt and both G_live prompts. The default remains dry-run; execution still requires --run.
runtime_agreement.authority: numpy f32 artifact oracle, explicitly not FP64 Numeric Parity V2.1
runtime_agreement.discrete_contract: exact argmax and ordered top-5 for every case

capability.change: The former --dry-run footgun no longer executes whole-model inference; explicit plan mode emits heavy_execution_started=false.
capability.artifact_verification: required; oracle shard verification is not disabled

whole_model_composition.admission: requires complete 282-shard/78-layer assembly, verified G_math and G_live approval, and exact three-prompt numpy-versus-Rust/Metal agreement under one artifact index SHA-256
whole_model_composition.claim_limit: proves end-to-end representation composition on the capability suite; does not claim teacher hidden-state parity, support halo, long context, broader quality, or speed

base_speed.short_profile: contexts 8 and 16, four decode tokens each
base_speed.sustained_profile: 2K/8K/32K contexts, at least 80 decode tokens, token curve and progressive JSONL
base_speed.evidence_binding: exact model index name and SHA-256, with verified artifact reads required

changes: accepts and identifies Gravity or activation-aware indexes
binds the receipt to the exact index SHA-256
records every currently admitted GLM runtime environment flag and its resolved state
does not describe an enabled flag profile as unaccelerated

support_halo.identity_contract: The local artifact index SHA-256 must equal /healthz before and after the run; the endpoint must attest base_runtime=true and fallback_present=false.
support_halo.completion_evidence: deterministic JSONL sidecar bound into the score receipt by SHA-256

long_context_quality.coverage: nine frozen partitions per rung, alternating retrieval and synthesis with disclosed position buckets
long_context_quality.identity_contract: Exact local index SHA-256 must match base-runtime /healthz before and after the run; fallback_present must remain false.
long_context_quality.scoring: exact greedy answer; all nine partition tasks must pass each rung

remaining_postpack_gaps: No activation-aware whole-model capability result exists until the pack is assembled.
No activation-aware runtime-agreement result exists until --run is used under a valid heavy window.
The frozen support-halo scorer is prepared but remains unexecuted until the cheap gates pass and a valid heavy window exists.
The whole-model composition gate is prepared but cannot pass until assembly, capability, and runtime-agreement receipts exist for one artifact hash.
Long-context quality and the sustained speed/TTFT/bytes/commands/memory/swap/thermal campaign are prepared but remain unexecuted.
